name: Bilocation (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School conjuration; Level psychic 9, shaman 9, sorcerer/wizard 9, witch 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 min./level (D)

DESCRIPTION

You split time and space allow you to exist in two places at once. The copy of yourself appears in an adjacent square. On your turn, both copies may move or make move-equivalent actions. All other actions are shared between the two, meaning only one standard or one swift action may be made between the two, but the actions may originate from either version of you. If one of you takes a full-round action, the other may still make their move or move-equivalent action. If both of you are within an area of effect, you are only affected once and only treated as one creature for targeting purposes. However conditions apply to both versions of you and you share hit points. If you are reduced to 0 hit points or killed, both versions of you remain until the spell expires. The link and the two versions of you may be separated by an unlimited amount of distance, even across planar boundaries. You choose which version of you is real when the spell expires or is dismissed.
